query:
SELECT n.nspname::text AS "schema!"
           FROM pg_namespace n
           WHERE n.nspname LIKE $1
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = n.oid
                         AND c.relname = 'blue_green_consensus_epoch' AND c.relkind = 'r')
           ORDER BY n.nspname
